shortDescription: Brocade Fibre Channel MAPS rule configuration

options.name: credential
options.description: login information including fos_ip_addr - ip address of the FOS switch fos_user_name - login name of FOS switch REST API fos_password - password of FOS switch REST API https - True for HTTPS, self for self-signed HTTPS, or False for HTTP

options.name: rules
options.description: list of rules to be updated. All writable attributes supported by BSN REST API with - replaced with _.

options.name: throttle
options.description: rest throttling delay in seconds to retry once more if server is busy.

options.name: timeout
options.description: rest timeout in seconds for operations taking longer than default timeout.

options.name: vfid
options.description: vfid of the switch to target. The value can be -1 for FOS without VF enabled. For VF enabled FOS, a valid vfid should be given
